
(function(){
  "use strict";
  const D=JSON.parse(document.getElementById("payload").textContent),N=D.n_nodes,T=D.n_time,SCALE=D.tbb_scale,LAT=D.lat,LON=D.lon,NLAT=LAT.length,NLON=LON.length;
  function b64bytes(s){const bin=atob(s),u=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);return u}
  const f32=s=>new Float32Array(b64bytes(s).buffer),i16=s=>new Int16Array(b64bytes(s).buffer);
  const TBB=i16(D.tbb_i16_b64);
  const EMB={pca:{"0":f32(D.pca.xy_b64)},tsne:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(D.tsne).map(([k,v])=>[k,f32(v)])),umap:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(D.umap).map(([k,v])=>[k,f32(v)]))};
  const PERPS=Object.keys(D.tsne).map(Number).sort((a,b)=>a-b),NNS=Object.keys(D.umap).map(Number).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  const TSMS=D.timestamps_utc.map(Date.parse),STEP=(()=>{const c=new Map;for(let i=1;i<T;i++){const d=TSMS[i]-TSMS[i-1];c.set(d,(c.get(d)||0)+1)}let best=TSMS[1]-TSMS[0],n=0;c.forEach((v,k)=>{if(v>n){n=v;best=k}});return best})();
  /* The day IS the 142 scenes the payload holds — the shipped matrix is the
     cleaned version, so there is no absent slot to reconstruct and nothing to
     mark as a gap. Everything in time is indexed by scene and placed on the
     clock by its own timestamp. */
  const DAY_START=Date.UTC(new Date(TSMS[0]).getUTCFullYear(),new Date(TSMS[0]).getUTCMonth(),new Date(TSMS[0]).getUTCDate());
  const T0=TSMS[0],T1=TSMS[T-1],SPAN=(T1-T0)||1;
  const nodeLat=i=>LAT[Math.floor(i/NLON)],nodeLon=i=>LON[i%NLON];
  const nodeMean=new Float32Array(N);let rawMin=Infinity,rawMax=-Infinity;
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){let sum=0;for(let t=0;t<T;t++){const v=TBB[i*T+t];sum+=v;if(v<rawMin)rawMin=v;if(v>rawMax)rawMax=v}nodeMean[i]=sum/T/SCALE}
  /* the 2–98 % stretch over the WHOLE day, not per frame: every frame of the
     film is painted against the same two ends, so "warmer" means warmer. */
  const STRETCH=(()=>{const hist=new Int32Array(rawMax-rawMin+1);for(const v of TBB)hist[v-rawMin]++;const at=q=>{const target=q*TBB.length;let a=0;for(let i=0;i<hist.length;i++){a+=hist[i];if(a>=target)return rawMin+i}return rawMax};return{lo:at(.02)/SCALE,hi:at(.98)/SCALE}})();

  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
  const css=n=>getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(n).trim();
  const fmt=n=>Number(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
  const f2=n=>n.toFixed(2);
  const clock=ms=>{const d=new Date(ms);return String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2,"0")+":"+String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2,"0")};
  const day=ms=>new Date(ms).toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const sceneTime=i=>TSMS[i];
  const fontFamily=()=>css("--font")||'system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif';

  /* ── the two colour scales, identical to the workflow page's ──────────────
     clusterScale() — OKLab, --div-neg → --div-pos, the page's every cluster
     mark, so C1…Ck read the same here as they do on the workflow page.
     heatScale()    — OKLab over --heat-0 … --heat-4 (plasma). tokens.css names
     this ramp for exactly this job: an unsigned intensity read off a SPATIAL
     LAYOUT. A one-hue blue ramp spends its whole range on lightness and takes
     the structure of the field with it, which is what made the old film a flat
     wash; plasma moves hue AND lightness, and its values are the same in both
     themes, so the film reads identically in light and dark. */
  const s2l=c=>c<=0.04045?c/12.92:Math.pow((c+0.055)/1.055,2.4);
  const l2s=c=>{c=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,c));return c<=0.0031308?12.92*c:1.055*Math.pow(c,1/2.4)-0.055};
  function hex2rgb(h){const v=String(h).trim().replace("#","");if(/^[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(v))return[...v].map(c=>parseInt(c+c,16));if(/^[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(v))return[0,2,4].map(i=>parseInt(v.slice(i,i+2),16));const m=String(h).match(/\d+/g);return m?m.slice(0,3).map(Number):[0,0,0]}
  function toOklab(hex){const rgb=hex2rgb(hex).map(v=>s2l(v/255)),r=rgb[0],g=rgb[1],b=rgb[2];
    const l=Math.cbrt(0.4122214708*r+0.5363325363*g+0.0514459929*b),m=Math.cbrt(0.2119034982*r+0.6806995451*g+0.1073969566*b),s=Math.cbrt(0.0883024619*r+0.2817188376*g+0.6299787005*b);
    return[0.2104542553*l+0.7936177850*m-0.0040720468*s,1.9779984951*l-2.4285922050*m+0.4505937099*s,0.0259040371*l+0.7827717662*m-0.8086757660*s]}
  function fromOklabRgb(L){const l=Math.pow(L[0]+0.3963377774*L[1]+0.2158037573*L[2],3),m=Math.pow(L[0]-0.1055613458*L[1]-0.0638541728*L[2],3),s=Math.pow(L[0]-0.0894841775*L[1]-1.2914855480*L[2],3);
    return[4.0767416621*l-3.3077115913*m+0.2309699292*s,-1.2684380046*l+2.6097574011*m-0.3413193965*s,-0.0041960863*l-0.7034186147*m+1.7076147010*s].map(v=>Math.round(l2s(v)*255))}
  const fromOklab=L=>{const c=fromOklabRgb(L);return"rgb("+c[0]+","+c[1]+","+c[2]+")"};
  function oklabScale(tokens){const labs=tokens.map(n=>toOklab(css(n)));return t=>{const u=t<0?0:t>1?1:t,x=u*(labs.length-1),j=Math.min(Math.floor(x),labs.length-2),g=x-j;return fromOklab([0,1,2].map(d=>labs[j][d]+g*(labs[j+1][d]-labs[j][d])))}}
  function oklabScaleRgb(tokens){const labs=tokens.map(n=>toOklab(css(n)));return t=>{const u=t<0?0:t>1?1:t,x=u*(labs.length-1),j=Math.min(Math.floor(x),labs.length-2),g=x-j;return fromOklabRgb([0,1,2].map(d=>labs[j][d]+g*(labs[j+1][d]-labs[j][d])))}}
  const HEAT_TOKENS=["--heat-0","--heat-1","--heat-2","--heat-3","--heat-4"];
  const CLUSTER_TOKENS=["--div-neg","--div-pos"];
  const clusterScale=()=>oklabScale(CLUSTER_TOKENS);
  const heatScale=()=>oklabScale(HEAT_TOKENS);
  function sampleScale(s,k){const out=[];for(let i=0;i<k;i++)out.push(s(k===1?0.5:i/(k-1)));return out}
  /* An ordered scale with two anchors gives adjacent ranks a step of 1/(k-1) of
     the whole path. At k = 6 that already puts C1 beside C2 as two almost
     identical blues; by k = 15 no neighbour is separable, and by k = 40 the
     whole chip row is one smear. Hue still marches cold → warm, so the ORDER is
     intact — what is missing is a second channel for telling neighbours apart.

     So the rank's PARITY is carried in OKLab lightness: odd ranks a step darker,
     even ranks a step lighter. Neighbours now differ in lightness wherever their
     hue does not, and the cold → warm reading is untouched because the hue path
     is not altered. It is a genuine second channel, not a decoration.

     It does not make 40 colours identifiable, because 40 identifiable colours do
     not exist. Past a handful of clusters the colour says "roughly where in the
     cold → warm order this group sits" and the chip row is what names a group —
     hover one and the page isolates it (renderChips).

     The workflow page samples the flat ramp, so above k = 2 a group's COLOUR can
     differ between the two pages. The PARTITION does not: same method, same
     parameter, same k, same members in the same C1…Ck order. */
  const PARITY_LIFT=.075;
  function clusterRamp(k){
    const a=toOklab(css(CLUSTER_TOKENS[0])),b=toOklab(css(CLUSTER_TOKENS[1])),out=[];
    const lift=k<3?0:PARITY_LIFT;
    for(let i=0;i<k;i++){
      const t=k===1?.5:i/(k-1);
      const L=[0,1,2].map(d=>a[d]+t*(b[d]-a[d]));
      L[0]+=i%2?lift:-lift;
      out.push(fromOklab(L));
    }
    return out;
  }
  const rampCss=stops=>"linear-gradient(to right,"+stops.join(",")+")";
  /* the cluster legend shows the k colours the plot actually uses, as hard
     steps — the encoding is discrete, and a smooth bar would misreport it */
  function stepsCss(stops){
    const seg=100/stops.length;
    return "linear-gradient(to right,"+stops.map((c,i)=>c+" "+(i*seg).toFixed(3)+"% "+((i+1)*seg).toFixed(3)+"%").join(",")+")";
  }

  /* opacity is the MAP pane's dial only: it is the measurement layer's own
     opacity over the basemap, so a reader can fade the clusters — or the film —
     down until the coastline underneath shows through, and back up again. The
     embedding pane has nothing underneath it and is never touched by it. */
  const state={method:"umap",nn:NNS.includes(15)?15:NNS[0],perp:PERPS.includes(30)?30:PERPS[0],k:6,
               hidden:new Set,focus:null,hover:null,pinned:Math.floor(N/2),curveScene:0,scene:0,
               mapMode:"clusters",basemap:false,opacity:.85,playing:false};
  const cache=new Map,view={embedding:null,map:null,curve:null};
  let frame=0,playTimer=0,geoImg=null,geoReady=false,filmBuf=null,filmCv=null;
  if(typeof D.basemap==="string"&&D.basemap.startsWith("data:")){geoImg=new Image;geoImg.onload=()=>{geoReady=true;drawMap()};geoImg.src=D.basemap}

  /* ── k-means, unchanged: k-means++, seed 1337, ≤ 60 iterations, 4 restarts,
        clusters relabelled by ascending mean TBB. Same settings, same payload
        and same relabelling as the workflow page, so the same method,
        parameter and k give the same clusters on both pages. ─────────────── */
  function mulberry32(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}
  function kmeans2d(xy,n,k,seed){
    let best=null;
    const restarts=k>20?2:4;
    for(let r=0;r<restarts;r++){
      const rnd=mulberry32(seed+r*7919);
      const cx=new Float64Array(k),cy=new Float64Array(k);
      const d2=new Float64Array(n).fill(Infinity);
      const i0=Math.floor(rnd()*n);
      cx[0]=xy[2*i0];cy[0]=xy[2*i0+1];
      for(let c=1;c<k;c++){
        let sum=0;
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
          const dx=xy[2*i]-cx[c-1],dy=xy[2*i+1]-cy[c-1];
          const d=dx*dx+dy*dy;
          if(d<d2[i])d2[i]=d;
          sum+=d2[i];
        }
        let target=rnd()*sum,idx=n-1;
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){target-=d2[i];if(target<=0){idx=i;break}}
        cx[c]=xy[2*idx];cy[c]=xy[2*idx+1];
      }
      const lab=new Int16Array(n);
      const cnt=new Int32Array(k),sx=new Float64Array(k),sy=new Float64Array(k);
      let inertia=0;
      for(let it=0;it<60;it++){
        let moved=0;inertia=0;
        cnt.fill(0);sx.fill(0);sy.fill(0);
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
          const x=xy[2*i],y=xy[2*i+1];
          let bi=0,bd=Infinity;
          for(let c=0;c<k;c++){
            const dx=x-cx[c],dy=y-cy[c],d=dx*dx+dy*dy;
            if(d<bd){bd=d;bi=c}
          }
          if(lab[i]!==bi){lab[i]=bi;moved++}
          inertia+=bd;cnt[bi]++;sx[bi]+=x;sy[bi]+=y;
        }
        for(let c=0;c<k;c++){
          if(cnt[c]>0){cx[c]=sx[c]/cnt[c];cy[c]=sy[c]/cnt[c]}
          else{const j=Math.floor(rnd()*n);cx[c]=xy[2*j];cy[c]=xy[2*j+1]}
        }
        if(moved===0&&it>0)break;
      }
      if(!best||inertia<best.inertia)best={labels:lab.slice(),inertia:inertia};
    }
    return best;
  }
  function relabelByTBB(labels,k){const sum=new Float64Array(k),cnt=new Int32Array(k);for(let i=0;i<N;i++){sum[labels[i]]+=nodeMean[i];cnt[labels[i]]++}const order=[...Array(k).keys()].sort((a,b)=>(sum[a]/(cnt[a]||1))-(sum[b]/(cnt[b]||1)));const map=new Int16Array(k);order.forEach((old,rank)=>{map[old]=rank});const out=new Int16Array(N);for(let i=0;i<N;i++)out[i]=map[labels[i]];return out}
  const param=()=>state.method==="umap"?state.nn:state.method==="tsne"?state.perp:0;
  const embedding=()=>state.method==="pca"?EMB.pca["0"]:EMB[state.method][String(param())];
  function labels(){const key=state.method+"|"+param()+"|"+state.k;if(!cache.has(key))cache.set(key,relabelByTBB(kmeans2d(embedding(),N,state.k,1337).labels,state.k));return cache.get(key)}
  function stats(){const lab=labels(),cnt=new Int32Array(state.k),sum=new Float64Array(state.k);for(let i=0;i<N;i++){cnt[lab[i]]++;sum[lab[i]]+=nodeMean[i]}return[...Array(state.k)].map((_,i)=>({c:i,n:cnt[i],mean:sum[i]/cnt[i]}))}

  /* ── canvas helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function fit(canvas){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(r.width*dpr));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(r.height*dpr));const g=canvas.getContext("2d");g.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);return{g,w:r.width,h:r.height}}
  /* the highlight ring is drawn on top of cluster marks AND of the film, so it
     carries its own halo instead of relying on the surface showing through */
  function ring(g,x,y,r){g.save();g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,r+2.5,0,Math.PI*2);g.lineWidth=3.5;g.strokeStyle=css("--surface-1");g.stroke();g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,r+2.5,0,Math.PI*2);g.lineWidth=1.6;g.strokeStyle=css("--text-primary");g.stroke();g.restore()}
  const activeNode=()=>state.hover==null?state.pinned:state.hover;
  /* A cluster switched off is DIMMED in the embedding and DROPPED from the map,
     and the difference is deliberate. The embedding's whole job is the shape of
     the manifold, and removing a cluster from it tears a hole in the very thing
     the reader is looking at — so those nodes stay on screen in grey and the
     shape survives. The map's job is where a group lands on the ground, and
     there an absent group is what lets the reader see past it to the basemap
     and to the groups underneath. */
  const visible=(i,lab)=>state.mapMode==="film"||
    (state.focus!=null?lab[i]===state.focus:!state.hidden.has(lab[i]));
  const isFilm=()=>state.mapMode==="film";
  const sceneNow=()=>state.scene;
  const heatT=q=>(q-STRETCH.lo)/(STRETCH.hi-STRETCH.lo);

  /* ── LEFT PANE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function drawEmbedding(){
    const cv=$("embeddingCanvas"),{g,w,h}=fit(cv),xy=embedding(),lab=labels(),pad=18;
    g.fillStyle=css("--surface-2");g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
    let x0=Infinity,x1=-Infinity,y0=Infinity,y1=-Infinity;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){x0=Math.min(x0,xy[2*i]);x1=Math.max(x1,xy[2*i]);y0=Math.min(y0,xy[2*i+1]);y1=Math.max(y1,xy[2*i+1])}
    const sx=x=>pad+(x-x0)/(x1-x0||1)*(w-2*pad),sy=y=>pad+(1-(y-y0)/(y1-y0||1))*(h-2*pad);
    const px=new Float32Array(N),py=new Float32Array(N);
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){px[i]=sx(xy[2*i]);py[i]=sy(xy[2*i+1])}
    /* in film mode BOTH panes carry the same frame, so the reader keeps the
       link between the computer's view and the geography while the day runs */
    if(isFilm()){
      const scene=sceneNow(),heat=heatScale();
      for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
        g.fillStyle=heat(heatT(TBB[i*T+scene]/SCALE));
        g.beginPath();g.arc(px[i],py[i],2.3,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();
      }
    }else{
      const colors=clusterRamp(state.k);
      g.globalAlpha=.85;
      /* grey first, colour over it: the dimmed nodes are the backdrop the kept
         clusters sit on, and painting them last would bury the selection */
      if(state.hidden.size||state.focus!=null){
        g.fillStyle=css("--muted");g.globalAlpha=.42;
        for(let i=0;i<N;i++){if(visible(i,lab))continue;g.beginPath();g.arc(px[i],py[i],2.15,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill()}
      }
      g.globalAlpha=.85;
      for(let i=0;i<N;i++){if(!visible(i,lab))continue;g.fillStyle=colors[lab[i]];g.beginPath();g.arc(px[i],py[i],2.15,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill()}
      g.globalAlpha=1;
    }
    const n=activeNode();
    ring(g,px[n],py[n],3);
    view.embedding={px,py,w,h,r:3};
    cv.setAttribute("aria-label",isFilm()
      ?methodName()+" embedding, every node coloured by its brightness temperature at "+clock(sceneTime(state.scene))+" UTC"
      :methodName()+" embedding with all "+fmt(N)+" nodes in "+state.k+" clusters"
        +(state.hidden.size?", "+state.hidden.size+" of them dimmed to grey":""));
  }

  /* ── RIGHT PANE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function mapFrame(w,h){
    const outer=Math.max(10,Math.min(22,w*.03));
    const mid=(LAT[0]+LAT[NLAT-1])/2*Math.PI/180;
    const aspect=Math.abs(LAT[NLAT-1]-LAT[0])/((LON[NLON-1]-LON[0])*Math.cos(mid));
    let fw=w-2*outer,fh=fw*aspect;
    if(fh>h-2*outer){fh=h-2*outer;fw=fh/aspect}
    return{gx:(w-fw)/2,gy:(h-fh)/2,fw,fh};
  }
  /* THE FILM. One ImageData of NLON × NLAT, drawn once with smoothing off.
     The old version painted 4 719 separate fillRects whose size did not divide
     the frame evenly, which is where the white grid across every frame came
     from; an image has no seams. */
  function paintFilm(g,scene,box){
    if(!filmCv){filmCv=document.createElement("canvas");filmCv.width=NLON;filmCv.height=NLAT;filmBuf=filmCv.getContext("2d").createImageData(NLON,NLAT)}
    const heat=oklabScaleRgb(HEAT_TOKENS),data=filmBuf.data;
    /* one lookup table of 256 steps, so a frame is a table read per node */
    const LUT=new Uint8Array(256*3);
    for(let s=0;s<256;s++){const c=heat(s/255);LUT[3*s]=c[0];LUT[3*s+1]=c[1];LUT[3*s+2]=c[2]}
    const lo=STRETCH.lo,span=(STRETCH.hi-STRETCH.lo)||1;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      let u=(TBB[i*T+scene]/SCALE-lo)/span;
      u=u<0?0:u>1?1:u;
      const s=(u*255)|0,o=4*i;
      data[o]=LUT[3*s];data[o+1]=LUT[3*s+1];data[o+2]=LUT[3*s+2];data[o+3]=255;
    }
    filmCv.getContext("2d").putImageData(filmBuf,0,0);
    /* half a cell of overhang on each side puts pixel CENTRES exactly on the
       node positions, then the frame clips the overhang away */
    const cw=box.fw/(NLON-1),ch=box.fh/(NLAT-1);
    g.save();
    g.beginPath();g.rect(box.gx,box.gy,box.fw,box.fh);g.clip();
    g.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
    g.drawImage(filmCv,box.gx-cw/2,box.gy-ch/2,box.fw+cw,box.fh+ch);
    g.restore();
  }
  function drawMap(){
    const cv=$("mapCanvas"),{g,w,h}=fit(cv),lab=labels(),box=mapFrame(w,h);
    g.fillStyle=css("--surface-2");g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
    const merc=lat=>Math.log(Math.tan(Math.PI/4+lat*Math.PI/360)),m0=merc(LAT[NLAT-1]),m1=merc(LAT[0]);
    const sx=lon=>box.gx+(lon-LON[0])/(LON[NLON-1]-LON[0])*box.fw,
          sy=lat=>box.gy+(m1-merc(lat))/(m1-m0)*box.fh;
    const px=new Float32Array(N),py=new Float32Array(N);
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){px[i]=sx(nodeLon(i));py[i]=sy(nodeLat(i))}
    const pitch=Math.min(box.fw/Math.max(1,NLON-1),box.fh/Math.max(1,NLAT-1)),r=Math.max(1,Math.min(3.2,pitch*.46));

    /* one order for both encodings: basemap underneath, the measurement layer
       over it at the reader's opacity. At 0 % the dial leaves the basemap
       unobstructed; at 100 % the measurement is unmixed. */
    if(state.basemap&&geoReady)g.drawImage(geoImg,box.gx,box.gy,box.fw,box.fh);
    if(isFilm()){
      if(state.opacity>0){g.save();g.globalAlpha=state.opacity;paintFilm(g,sceneNow(),box);g.restore()}
    }else if(state.opacity>0){
      const colors=clusterRamp(state.k);
      g.globalAlpha=state.opacity;
      for(let i=0;i<N;i++){if(!visible(i,lab))continue;g.fillStyle=colors[lab[i]];g.beginPath();g.arc(px[i],py[i],r,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill()}
      g.globalAlpha=1;
    }
    g.strokeStyle=css("--axis");g.lineWidth=1;g.strokeRect(box.gx+.5,box.gy+.5,box.fw-1,box.fh-1);
    const n=activeNode();
    if(isFilm()||visible(n,lab))ring(g,px[n],py[n],Math.max(3,r+1));
    view.map={px,py,w,h,r};
    cv.setAttribute("aria-label",isFilm()
      ?"Geographic grid painted with the measured brightness temperature at "+clock(sceneTime(state.scene))+" UTC"
      :"Geographic grid with the same "+state.k+" clusters as the embedding");
  }

  /* ── THE DAY CURVE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function drawCurve(){
    const cv=$("curveCanvas"),{g,w,h}=fit(cv),node=activeNode(),pad={l:52,r:14,t:14,b:28};
    g.fillStyle=css("--surface-1");g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
    let lo=Infinity,hi=-Infinity;
    for(let t=0;t<T;t++){const q=TBB[node*T+t]/SCALE;lo=Math.min(lo,q);hi=Math.max(hi,q)}
    const room=Math.max(1,(hi-lo)*.12);lo-=room;hi+=room;
    /* x is real UTC time, not a scene ordinal, so the curve keeps the true
       spacing of the measurements the file holds */
    const sx=ms=>pad.l+(ms-T0)/SPAN*(w-pad.l-pad.r),sy=q=>pad.t+(1-(q-lo)/(hi-lo))*(h-pad.t-pad.b);
    g.strokeStyle=css("--grid");g.lineWidth=1;
    [0,.5,1].forEach(f=>{const y=pad.t+f*(h-pad.t-pad.b);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(pad.l,y+.5);g.lineTo(w-pad.r,y+.5);g.stroke()});
    g.fillStyle=css("--muted");g.font="10px "+fontFamily();g.textAlign="right";
    g.fillText(Math.round(hi)+" K",pad.l-7,pad.t+4);
    g.fillText(Math.round(lo)+" K",pad.l-7,h-pad.b+4);
    g.textAlign="center";
    [0,6,12,18,23].forEach(hr=>{const ms=DAY_START+hr*3600000;if(ms>=T0&&ms<=T1)g.fillText(String(hr).padStart(2,"0")+":00",sx(ms),h-9)});
    g.strokeStyle=css("--series-1");g.lineWidth=1.8;g.lineJoin="round";g.beginPath();
    for(let t=0;t<T;t++){const x=sx(TSMS[t]),y=sy(TBB[node*T+t]/SCALE);if(t===0)g.moveTo(x,y);else g.lineTo(x,y)}
    g.stroke();
    const scene=state.curveScene,cx=sx(TSMS[scene]);
    g.strokeStyle=css("--text-primary");g.lineWidth=1;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(cx+.5,pad.t);g.lineTo(cx+.5,h-pad.b);g.stroke();
    ring(g,cx,sy(TBB[node*T+scene]/SCALE),2.2);
    view.curve={sx,pad,w,h};
    const lat=nodeLat(node).toFixed(2),lon=nodeLon(node).toFixed(2);
    $("nodeReadout").textContent="Node "+fmt(node+1)+" · C"+(labels()[node]+1);
    $("curveReadout").innerHTML=lat+"° N · "+lon+"° E<br>day mean <b>"+f2(nodeMean[node])+" K</b><br>"
      +clock(TSMS[scene])+" UTC · <b>"+f2(TBB[node*T+scene]/SCALE)+" K</b>";
    cv.setAttribute("aria-label","All "+T+" measurements for node "+(node+1)+", "+clock(T0)+" to "+clock(T1)+" UTC");
  }

  /* ── labels, legends, chips ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const methodName=()=>state.method==="pca"?"PCA":state.method==="tsne"?"t-SNE":"UMAP";
  function updateLabels(){
    const p=param();
    $("embeddingSub").textContent=(state.method==="pca"?"first two components":state.method==="tsne"?"perplexity "+p:"n_neighbors "+p)
      +(isFilm()?" · painted by this scene"
        :state.focus!=null?" · C"+(state.focus+1)+" isolated"
        :state.hidden.size?" · "+state.hidden.size+" cluster"+(state.hidden.size>1?"s":"")+" dimmed":"");
    $("mapSub").textContent=isFilm()
      ?clock(sceneTime(state.scene))+" UTC · scene "+(state.scene+1)+" of "+T
      :state.k+" linked clusters";
    $("mapPaneLabel").textContent="north ↑ · "+(state.basemap?"coastline revealed":"coastline hidden")
      +" · "+Math.round(state.opacity*100)+" % opacity";
    $("ptOpVal").textContent=Math.round(state.opacity*100)+" %";
    $("clusterLegend").hidden=isFilm();
    $("filmLegend").hidden=!isFilm();
  }
  function paintLegends(){
    $("clusterBar").style.background=stepsCss(clusterRamp(state.k));
    $("clusterHi").textContent="C"+state.k+" · warmest";
    $("filmBar").style.background=rampCss(sampleScale(heatScale(),24));
    $("filmLo").textContent="≤ "+f2(STRETCH.lo)+" K";
    $("filmHi").textContent="≥ "+f2(STRETCH.hi)+" K";
  }
  function renderChips(){
    /* the row is rebuilt, so the chip the cursor was over no longer exists and
       will never send its pointerleave — drop the isolate rather than strand it */
    state.focus=null;
    const s=stats(),colors=clusterRamp(state.k),box=$("clusterChips");
    /* the swatch carries the colour the reader will actually find in the
       embedding — grey once the cluster is switched off */
    const grey=css("--muted");
    box.innerHTML=s.map(o=>'<button type="button" class="chip" data-c="'+o.c+'" aria-pressed="'+(!state.hidden.has(o.c))+'">'
      +'<span class="sw" style="background:'+(state.hidden.has(o.c)?grey:colors[o.c])+'"></span>C'+(o.c+1)
      +' <span class="n">'+fmt(o.n)+'</span></button>').join("");
    box.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>{
      const c=Number(b.dataset.c);
      b.addEventListener("click",()=>{
        state.hidden.has(c)?state.hidden.delete(c):state.hidden.add(c);
        renderChips();drawLinked();
      });
      /* ISOLATE ON HOVER. Past a handful of clusters no palette can name a group
         by colour, so the chip does the naming: point at it and that group keeps
         its colour while every other node drops to grey in the embedding and off
         the map. This is what makes k = 40 readable — one group at a time, from
         a row of labels, instead of forty colours nobody can tell apart.
         Keyboard gets the same thing through focus/blur, so tabbing the row
         walks the clusters one by one. */
      const on=()=>{if(state.focus!==c){state.focus=c;scheduleLinked()}};
      const off=()=>{if(state.focus===c){state.focus=null;scheduleLinked()}};
      b.addEventListener("pointerenter",on);
      b.addEventListener("pointerleave",off);
      b.addEventListener("focus",on);
      b.addEventListener("blur",off);
    });
    paintLegends();
  }
  function updateTime(){
    $("timeSlider").value=state.scene;
    $("timeNow").textContent=clock(sceneTime(state.scene))+" UTC · scene "+(state.scene+1)+"/"+T;
    updateLabels();
  }
  function drawLinked(){drawEmbedding();drawMap();drawCurve();updateLabels()}
  function scheduleLinked(){cancelAnimationFrame(frame);frame=requestAnimationFrame(drawLinked)}

  /* ── pointer linking ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function nearest(evt,kind){
    const box=evt.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(),x=evt.clientX-box.left,y=evt.clientY-box.top,o=view[kind];
    if(!o)return null;
    /* nothing of the layer is on screen, so there is nothing to point at */
    if(kind==="map"&&state.opacity===0)return null;
    const lab=labels();
    let best=-1,bd=kind==="map"?Math.max(8,o.r*2.4)**2:100;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      /* a dimmed node is still on screen in the embedding, so it stays
         pointable there; on the map it is not drawn, so it is not */
      if(kind==="map"&&!visible(i,lab))continue;
      const dx=o.px[i]-x,dy=o.py[i]-y,d=dx*dx+dy*dy;
      if(d<bd){bd=d;best=i}
    }
    return best<0?null:best;
  }
  function showTip(kind,evt,node){
    const tip=$(kind+"Tip"),wrap=$(kind+"Wrap"),r=wrap.getBoundingClientRect(),x=evt.clientX-r.left,y=evt.clientY-r.top;
    const scene=sceneNow();
    tip.hidden=false;
    tip.innerHTML="<b>Node "+fmt(node+1)+" · C"+(labels()[node]+1)+"</b><br>"
      +'<span class="k">day mean</span> '+f2(nodeMean[node])+" K"
      +(isFilm()?'<br><span class="k">'+clock(sceneTime(scene))+" UTC</span> "+f2(TBB[node*T+scene]/SCALE)+" K":"")
      +'<br><span class="k">click to keep this curve</span>';
    const half=tip.offsetWidth/2+6;
    tip.style.left=Math.max(half,Math.min(r.width-half,x))+"px";
    if(y<tip.offsetHeight+18){tip.style.top=(y+13)+"px";tip.style.transform="translate(-50%,0)"}
    else{tip.style.top=y+"px";tip.style.transform="translate(-50%,calc(-100% - 12px))"}
  }
  function wireCanvas(kind){
    const cv=$(kind+"Canvas"),tip=$(kind+"Tip");
    cv.addEventListener("pointermove",evt=>{
      const n=nearest(evt,kind);
      if(n==null){if(state.hover!==null){state.hover=null;scheduleLinked()}tip.hidden=true;return}
      if(n!==state.hover){state.hover=n;scheduleLinked()}
      showTip(kind,evt,n);
    });
    cv.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>{state.hover=null;tip.hidden=true;scheduleLinked()});
    cv.addEventListener("click",evt=>{const n=nearest(evt,kind);if(n!=null){state.pinned=n;state.hover=null;tip.hidden=true;drawLinked()}});
  }

  /* ── controls ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function fillParams(){
    const sel=$("paramSel");
    if(state.method==="pca"){$("paramLabel").textContent="Components";sel.innerHTML='<option value="0">2 shown</option>';sel.disabled=true}
    else{
      const arr=state.method==="umap"?NNS:PERPS,val=state.method==="umap"?state.nn:state.perp;
      $("paramLabel").textContent=state.method==="umap"?"n_neighbors":"Perplexity";
      sel.innerHTML=arr.map(x=>'<option value="'+x+'">'+x+'</option>').join("");
      sel.value=String(val);sel.disabled=false;
    }
  }
  function setMethod(){state.method=$("methodSel").value;state.hidden.clear();fillParams();renderChips();drawLinked()}
  function setMapMode(mode){
    state.mapMode=mode;
    $("clusterMode").setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(mode==="clusters"));
    $("filmMode").setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(mode==="film"));
    updateTime();drawEmbedding();drawMap();
  }
  function stepTime(d){state.scene=(state.scene+d+T)%T;state.curveScene=state.scene;if(!isFilm())setMapMode("film");else{updateTime();drawEmbedding();drawMap()}drawCurve()}
  function stop(){state.playing=false;clearInterval(playTimer);const b=$("playBtn");b.setAttribute("aria-pressed","false");b.setAttribute("aria-label","Play the day");$("playIcon").innerHTML='<path d="M4 2v10l8-5z" fill="currentColor"/>'}
  function play(){
    if(state.playing){stop();return}
    state.playing=true;setMapMode("film");
    const b=$("playBtn");b.setAttribute("aria-pressed","true");b.setAttribute("aria-label","Pause the day");
    $("playIcon").innerHTML='<path d="M3.5 2h2.5v10H3.5zM8 2h2.5v10H8z" fill="currentColor"/>';
    playTimer=setInterval(()=>stepTime(1),190);
  }

  /* ── theme: the suite's contract — ?theme=, #themeBtn, the OS preference and
        a data-theme stamp from an embedder. CSS re-themes itself; canvas pixels
        do not, so every one of the four paths repaints. ────────────────────── */
  const isDark=()=>{const x=document.documentElement.dataset.theme;return x?x==="dark":matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches};
  function initTheme(){PC.registerRepaint(()=>{paintLegends();scheduleLinked()})}

  function initText(){
    $("timeSlider").max=T-1;
    $("ptOp").value=String(Math.round(state.opacity*100));
    $("ptOpVal").textContent=Math.round(state.opacity*100)+" %";
  }

  function wire(){
    wireCanvas("embedding");wireCanvas("map");
    $("methodSel").addEventListener("change",setMethod);
    $("paramSel").addEventListener("change",e=>{
      if(state.method==="umap")state.nn=Number(e.target.value);else if(state.method==="tsne")state.perp=Number(e.target.value);
      state.hidden.clear();renderChips();drawLinked();
    });
    $("kSlider").addEventListener("input",e=>{
      state.k=Number(e.target.value);$("kOut").textContent=state.k;state.hidden.clear();
      requestAnimationFrame(()=>{renderChips();drawLinked()});
    });
    $("revealBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{
      state.basemap=!state.basemap;
      $("revealBtn").setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(state.basemap));
      $("revealBtn").textContent=state.basemap?"Hide the map":"Reveal the map";
      drawMap();updateLabels();
    });
    $("ptOp").addEventListener("input",e=>{
      state.opacity=Number(e.target.value)/100;
      drawMap();updateLabels();
    });
    $("clusterMode").addEventListener("click",()=>{stop();setMapMode("clusters")});
    $("filmMode").addEventListener("click",()=>setMapMode("film"));
    $("timeSlider").addEventListener("input",e=>{
      stop();state.scene=Number(e.target.value);state.curveScene=state.scene;
      if(!isFilm())setMapMode("film");else{updateTime();drawEmbedding();drawMap()}
      drawCurve();
    });
    $("prevBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{stop();stepTime(-1)});
    $("nextBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{stop();stepTime(1)});
    $("playBtn").addEventListener("click",play);
    $("curveCanvas").addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{
      const r=e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(),x=e.clientX-r.left,o=view.curve;
      if(!o)return;
      /* x is a clock position, so pick the scene whose own timestamp is nearest
         to it rather than dividing the axis into equal ordinals */
      const want=T0+Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(x-o.pad.l)/(o.w-o.pad.l-o.pad.r)))*SPAN;
      let best=0,bd=Infinity;
      for(let t=0;t<T;t++){const d=Math.abs(TSMS[t]-want);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=t}}
      state.curveScene=best;
      drawCurve();
    });
    addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape"){stop();state.hidden.clear();state.hover=null;renderChips();drawLinked()}});
    addEventListener("resize",()=>{clearTimeout(window.__resizeT);window.__resizeT=setTimeout(drawLinked,100)});
  }

  window.__TBB_INSIGHT__={
    snapshot:()=>({method:state.method,parameter:param(),k:state.k,labels:Array.from(labels()),
                   scenes:T,scene:state.scene,hoverNode:state.hover,pinnedNode:state.pinned,
                   mapMode:state.mapMode,basemap:state.basemap,opacity:state.opacity}),
    screenPoint:(kind,node)=>{const o=view[kind];return o&&node>=0&&node<N?[o.px[node],o.py[node]]:null}
  };

  initTheme();initText();fillParams();wire();renderChips();updateTime();drawLinked();
})();
